snippet.title: StoneEra — NEW Gameplay Trailer | October 2026
snippet.description:
Build a settlement from the ground up in StoneEra, a voxel colony and survival game.
Gather resources, design your own homes, and develop production chains. Put cranes, lifts, and water-powered machinery to work as you shape the terrain and grow your colony through changing seasons.
Play the free demo and wishlist StoneEra on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5057770/StoneEra/
#StoneEra #ColonySim #BaseBuilding #IndieGame
Steam-ում վերբեռնումը շարունակում եմ։
